fit_scope: The genuine country exclusion and every equal-size matched removal use complete fixed-pipeline refits; the 50 matched-removal penalties are averaged within country
plausible_value_scope: First reading plausible value only; matched controls were not computed for PV2-PV10
analytic_distribution: Unweighted 48,000-student equal-country analytic sample across 32 observed countries, with each point evaluated in its named observed held-out country
comparison_definition: Mean size-matched no-target-country RMSE minus ordinary common-split OOF RMSE (Cbar-A); this is the focal training-size-matched observed-country exclusion/composition diagnostic
x_axis: Size-matched exclusion/composition penalty Cbar-A, in RMSE points
y_axis: Observed held-out country, ordered by Cbar-A
zero_reference: No difference from ordinary common-split OOF RMSE
point_layer: Country contrast points are rendered above the zero reference and connecting segments
uncertainty_semantics: Horizontal ranges span the 50 deterministic Ccr-A values and are descriptive repeated-fit ranges, not confidence intervals; points are country means
bootstrap_unit: Not applicable; matched removal repetitions are descriptive controls, not bootstrap draws
refit_status: Complete fixed learner pipeline refitted for the genuine exclusion and every matched removal
omitted_uncertainty: Across-plausible-value, learner-selection, survey-design, future-cycle, and new-country uncertainty are omitted
